title: Workspace allows every dependency to run install scripts
description: pnpm-workspace.yaml declares a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts. A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts.
remediation: Move the step out of the install lifecycle into an explicit, reviewed command that the build runs on purpose. Specifically: fix a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts.
limitation: It matches a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts in the parsed pnpm-workspace.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
